common.offline: Awuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kudinga uxhumano; kuzosebenza futhi uma usubuyile.

onboarding.documentTitle: Khokha kunoma iyiphi i-spaza ngenoma iyiphi iwalethi
onboarding.body: Thatha izinkokhelo nge-QR code kuphela. Awudingi umshini wamakhadi, isebenzisa idatha encane kakhulu, futhi iyaqhubeka isebenza noma isiginali ingekho.

setup.title: Misa isitolo sakho
setup.nameHint: Amakhasimende abona leli gama uma ekhokha.

existing.title: Le foni isivele isebenzisa i-{{shop}}
existing.description: Isitolo esisha sizothatha indawo yaso kule foni, futhi le foni ngeke isakwazi ukuvula esidala.

wallet.nameHint: Igama lewalethi yakho kuphela: ingxenye engemuva kuka-/.
wallet.fullHint: Liqala ngo-$ noma ngo-https://. Lithole ku-app yewalethi yakho.

poster.title: Iphosta yakho ye-QR
poster.hint: Yiphrinte ngo-A5 bese uyibeka lapho amakhasimende engayiskena khona.

connect.title: Ixhuma isitolo sakho

notFound.title: Isitolo asitholakali
notFound.description: Hlola ikhodi ye-QR, noma ucele isitolo isixhumanisi saso.

quote.title: Qinisekisa inkokhelo
quote.includes: Kufakwe zonke izindleko nezinga lokushintshaniswa kwemali.

customer.title: Khokha esitolo
customer.scan: Khomba ikhamera yefoni yakho kukhodi ye-QR yesitolo. Ivula ikhasi lokukhokha, ayikho i-app edingekayo.
customer.codeHint: Iphrintiwe kuphosta yesitolo, ngaphansi kwekhodi ye-QR.

receipt.title: Inkokhelo

waiting.title: Kulindwe imvume
waiting.description: Vumela inkokhelo ewalethini yakho ukuze uqedele.

receipt.callbackError: Asikakwazi ukuqinisekisa imvume yakho. Hlola iwalethi yakho ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.

empty.title: Azikabikho izinkokhelo
empty.description: Izinkokhelo zivela lapha ngokushesha uma zingena, futhi ifoni yakho ingazifunda ngezwi.

setUp.title: Asikabikho isitolo kule foni
setUp.description: Ukumisa kuthatha ngaphansi kwemizuzu emibili: ikheli lewalethi yakho negama lesitolo.

unauthorized.title: Le foni iphumile esitolo
unauthorized.description: Vula isixhumanisi sesitolo sakho futhi, noma umise isitolo futhi.

failures.consent_declined: Inkokhelo inqatshiwe ewalethini. Ayikho imali ethathiwe.
failures.consent_invalid: Imvume ayikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa, ngakho ayikho imali ethathiwe.
failures.consent_timeout: Inkokhelo ayivunyelwanga ngesikhathi. Ayikho imali ethathiwe.
failures.quote_expired: Intengo iphelelwe yisikhathi ngaphambi kokuthi inkokhelo ivunyelwe. Sicela uzame futhi.
failures.insufficient_funds: Iwalethi ayinayo imali eyanele yale nkokhelo.
failures.timeout: Imali ithatha isikhathi eside ukufika. Hlola iwalethi ngaphambi kokukhokha futhi.

tab.title: Amathebhu ami

empty.title: Awekho amathebhu avuliwe
empty.description: Vula ithebhu e-spaza yakho kanye nje, bese ukhokha ngokuthinta, ngisho noma isiginali ingekho.

tab.howToOpen: Skena ikhodi ye-QR yesitolo, bese ukhetha Vula ithebhu kulesi sitolo.

open.title: Vula ithebhu
open.intro: Khokha e-{{shop}} ngokuthinta, ngisho noma ayikho ifoni enesiginali. Uvuma umkhawulo wesonto kanye, ku-wallet yakho.
open.labelHint: Isitolo sibona leli gama eduze nethebhu yakho.
open.capHint: Okuningi kakhulu le thebhu engakuthatha ngesonto. Iwalethi yakho iyibamba kulowo mkhawulo.
open.offline: Ukuvula ithebhu kudinga isiginali kanye. Ngemva kwalokho isebenza ngaphandle kwayo.

detail.waiting: Vuma umkhawulo wesonto ku-wallet yakho ukuze uqale ukusebenzisa le thebhu.
detail.failed: Le thebhu ayivulwanga. Ayikho imali ethathiwe.
detail.callbackError: Asikwazanga ukuqinisekisa imvume yakho. Hlola iwalethi yakho, bese uzama ukuvula ithebhu futhi.
detail.otherPhone: Le thebhu ivulwe kwenye ifoni, ngakho yileyo foni kuphela engakhokha ngayo.
detail.howToPay: Ukukhokha, cela isitolo ukuthengisa ngethebhu bese uskena ikhodi ye-QR abakukhombisa yona.

settings.title: Izilungiselelo
settings.simulateOfflineHint: Ikhombisa ukusebenza kwethebhu ngaphandle kwesiginali ngaphandle kokuvala ifoni. Akukho okufika kuseva uze uyicishe.

offline.banner: Awuxhumekile ku-inthanethi. I-AnyPay iyaqhubeka isebenza futhi izovumelanisa uma usubuyile.

sale.hint: Kumakhasimende anethebhu esitolo sakho. Kusebenza ngaphandle kwesiginali.

sale.syncFailed: Asikwazanga ukubuyekeza amathebhu amakhasimende. Sisebenzisa lawo akule foni.

noTabs.title: Awekho amathebhu okwamanje
noTabs.description: Uma ikhasimende livula ithebhu esitolo sakho, ungalithengisela lapha, ngisho noma isiginali ingekho.

approve.noTab: Awunayo ithebhu kulesi sitolo kule foni. Vula eyodwa uma unesiginali.
approve.capReached: Lokhu kungaphezu kwalokho okusele kuthebhu yakho kuleli sonto.
approve.expired: Lesi sicelo sesidala kakhulu. Cela isitolo esisha.
